title: Learning piano and guitar chords
summary: No piano teacher; he picked it up from banjo and guitar and got some chord lessons from Johnny Sincere, not learning to read.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I was going to ask a little bit about when you started on piano, did you have, that's already going there. Did you have anybody to show you on piano, give you lessons or?
No, I just picked it up from the banjo, from the guitar on the banjo.
Now, on the banjo you said Johnny Sincere.
Well, Johnny Sincere on the guitar, yeah. First, you know, I got some lessons from him, because I liked it and I used to worry life out of him to show him some chords, you know what I mean?
I got a whole outfit there, no, no. Did that on the guitar?
I got a guitar, I got an amplifier, I got a recording outfit and everything right in there.
Did he teach you to read or just show you the chords?
No, he just showed me the chords, no. In other words, I was a sort of a catch-behind musician, you know?
Show me this, uh, sure, man.
